wordmark.purpose: Footer brand sign-off only (a viewport-spanning CASHU.ME). A brand mark, not a heading; sits outside the Display hierarchy. The 3.25rem floor keeps the unbreakable word inside a 320px viewport.

display-1.purpose: Hero statement. One per page. The hero <h1> carries a one-off uppercase + loosened-tracking override; other Display 1 usages stay mixed-case.

display-2.purpose: Section headings ("What's different.", "Who holds the bitcoin.").

display-3.purpose: Sub-section / smaller display moments, including bento card titles.

lead.purpose: Standalone introductory paragraphs following a Display heading. Capped at 48-55ch.

body.purpose: Pillar / column / accordion prose, capped at 65ch. Ships as the type-body-lg utility at 1.0625rem / 1.6.

label.purpose: Structural labels: footer column headers, footer copyright line, chip/badge text.

button.purpose: Every CTA, outline button, and store-badge label. Sized by the consuming component, not the utility.

subhead.purpose: The one display-face step below Display 3 — section sub-headings needing Manrope at body-adjacent scale.

badge-kicker.purpose: The 11px muted top row inside store badges (DOWNLOAD BETA ON). Component-scoped, not on the display ramp.

shadows.name: glass-frost
shadows.purpose: The one shared frosted-glass surface: buttons, the nav bar, custody-comparison's checkpoint band/chips, and the bento cards. Theme-aware token: light = inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.55), 0 8px 24px -12px rgba(30,64,120,0.28); dark = inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.08), 0 8px 24px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.6). Borders come from --glass-border (white/50 light, white/14 dark) and --glass-border-strong on hover/scroll (white/70 light, white/22 dark).

focusRing.purpose: Uniform keyboard focus across a, button, [role=button], summary, and Radix collection items. The 2px radius belongs to the ring, not to any surface.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The frosted-glass CTA. Used at most once per section (header nav CTA, mobile drawer CTA). Source recipe for every other glass surface on the page.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; white-space: nowrap; height: 44px; padding: 0 20px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: "Azeret Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: oklch(16% 0.015 260); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.5); background: rgba(207,229,247,0.55); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.55), 0 8px 24px -12px rgba(30,64,120,0.28); transition: background-color 150ms, border-color 150ms, transform 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); background: rgba(207,229,247,0.75); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5b46d4; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action adjacent to a primary CTA ("View source").

components.name: Nav Bar
components.description: Floating glass header, rounded to match the button radius. Persistent from first paint (not scroll-gated), insets from the top/sides, intensifies slightly past 20px of scroll.
components.html: cashu.meOpen Wallet
components.css: .ds-nav-shell { display: flex; justify-content: center; padding: 0 16px; } .ds-nav-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; width: 100%; max-width: 1024px; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.5); background: rgba(207,229,247,0.55); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.55), 0 8px 24px -12px rgba(30,64,120,0.28); transition: background-color 500ms, border-color 500ms; } .ds-nav-brand { font-family: "Manrope", sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: oklch(16% 0.015 260); }

components.name: Bento Card
components.description: The one card-like container the system uses. Carries the button glass recipe instead of a flat bg-muted/hairline-border treatment.
components.html:
Account wallets see everything.

Every send, every receive, every contact, tied to a single account in someone else's database.
components.css: .ds-bento-card { position: relative; overflow: hidden; padding: 32px 32px 0; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.5); background: rgba(207,229,247,0.55); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.55), 0 8px 24px -12px rgba(30,64,120,0.28); } .ds-bento-card h3 { font-family: "Manrope", sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: clamp(28px, 3vw, 48px); color: oklch(16% 0.015 260); } .ds-bento-card p { margin-top: 16px; font-family: "Geist Sans", sans-serif; font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.6; color: rgba(20,24,31,0.7); }

components.name: Custodial Field Chip
components.description: Custody-comparison's field chips (ID, TO, amount, timestamp) and checkpoint band carry the button glass recipe rather than a flat hairline border. Scoped to this illustration, not a general chip pattern.

components.name: Valid Chip
components.description: Mint-lane "VALID" chip. Same glass recipe as the custodial field chip, with the Scan Color Exemption's green tint layered on top (container styling only, color system unchanged).

components.name: Store Badge
components.description: Two-line install chip for the hero and mobile drawer: platform mark plus a DOWNLOAD BETA ON / <store> label. Same frosted-glass recipe as buttons, taller (h-16) for the second line. Ships as AppStoreBadge (Apple/TestFlight), ZapstoreBadge (Android/Zapstore), and BrowserBadge (globe/no-install).
components.html: Download Beta onZapstore
components.css: .ds-store-badge { display: inline-flex; height: 4rem; align-items: center; gap: 0.875rem; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--background) 55%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(16px); padding: 0 1.25rem; color: var(--foreground); text-decoration: none; box-shadow: var(--glass-shadow); transition: border-color 250ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), background-color 250ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1), translate 250ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-store-badge:hover { border-color: var(--glass-border-strong); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--background) 75%, transparent); translate: 0 -2px; } .ds-store-badge:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-store-badge:active { scale: 0.98; } .ds-store-badge-icon { width: 2rem; height: 2rem; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-store-badge-label { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; line-height: 1; } .ds-store-badge-kicker { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-store-badge-store { margin-top: 0.25rem; font-family: var(--font-mono); font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 18px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-store-badge:hover { translate: none; } .ds-store-badge:active { scale: 1; } }

narrative.overview: cashu.me is a specimen page for a piece of digital cash. Type is the artifact. The page reads like a museum caption: dispassionate, precise, large, asking the viewer to look without selling them anything. The visitor moves down the page the way you move down a printed broadsheet, not the way you scroll a feed. The surface is a single continuous daylight sky: a near-flat blue gradient with a small library of photographic cloud cutouts as ambient decoration. Interactive surfaces (buttons, the nav, a handful of named illustration and card elements) carry a soft frosted-glass material: translucent, blurred, hairline-bordered. Everything else stays flat: type on sky, hairline rules, no ambient shadows. The aesthetic is editorial and committed, not enterprise; restraint is the voice. The single chromatic note is a soft lilac reserved for emphasis. The page rejects the dominant crypto-site reflexes (neon-on-black, chart-heavy dashboards, consumer-fintech pastels, bank navy-and-gold); its one material departure from a flat, glassmorphism-free web is the frosted-glass recipe, scoped to four named surfaces, not applied ambiently.
keyCharacteristics: Editorial scale (hero up to ~10.5rem at large viewports), tight tracking (-0.035em in mixed case), short leading (1 on Display 1).
One continuous daylight-sky surface page-wide; clouds are photographic cutouts, small, ambient, never the subject.

A full night theme follows the system preference (next-themes, data-theme attribute, pre-paint script) with a persistent sun/moon toggle in the nav: the sky collapses to a flat near-black oklch(13% 0.003 280) and the same white-alpha cloud PNGs dim to moonlit gray via --cloud-filter: brightness(0.42).
Lilac accent used sparingly: CTA hover, link underlines, ::selection. Never large fields.
One shared frosted-glass recipe, reused verbatim on buttons, the nav bar, custody-comparison's checkpoint/chips, and the bento cards — four named surfaces, one recipe.
Native <details> accordion, native <a> rectangular buttons. No bespoke widgets where the platform suffices.
Phone placeholders maintain device proportions (9:19.5); no skeuomorphic chrome.

rules.name: The Ambient Sky Rule
rules.body: The sky is ambient, not the subject. Clouds are photographic cutouts (never cartoon/illustrated shapes) — a 7-shape library sourced *only* from Resource Boy's cloud textures (`/public/images/clouds`, placements in `src/lib/clouds.ts`; served `unoptimized` — next/image's AVIF/WebP re-encoding visibly destroys soft alpha edges at these sizes, the same reason the logo is served `unoptimized` too, see §5 Navigation). Sized larger on desktop (~80–380px) than on the small mobile subset (~50–200px, via each placement's `mobileWidth`). At most ~3 clouds visible per viewport-height; they live in gutters, beside headings, and at section seams — never behind running text or interactive targets; always `aria-hidden` + `pointer-events: none`. Motion is a single global scroll-progress value driving transform-only X drift and Y parallax; reduced-motion renders them static at their resting position (never removes them); below `md` only a small flagged subset renders, without drift. If a section reads "cloudy," the rule is broken.

rules.name: The Night Sky
rules.body: The dark theme follows the system preference (next-themes on `data-theme`, pre-paint script, no flash of the wrong theme) with a persistent manual override; nothing stored always means follow the OS. At night the sky collapses to one flat near-black field: `--sky-top` = `--sky-bottom` = `--background` = `oklch(13% 0.003 280)` (≈ `#070708`, lilac-tinted per the No-Pure-Black rule). The cloud library is theme-invariant: the cutouts are pure white + alpha, so the same PNGs serve both skies, dimmed to moonlit gray via `--cloud-filter: brightness(0.42)`. That value is a contrast ceiling, not taste: foreground over the densest cloud core (max alpha 242/255) is 5.4:1 at 0.42 and falls to 4.05:1 at 0.5 — never raise it past 0.45. On the night field: foreground 19.0:1, muted 7.5:1, Cashu Lilac 9.4:1, scan green 14.3:1. Theme switching flips CSS custom properties only — same image assets, no layout, no network.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Cashu Lilac is the sole chromatic note in the system. It appears on no more than ~5% of any given screen. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Scan Color Exemption
rules.body: The `--scan` token (`#16a34a` on light / `#86efac` on dark) is the sole sanctioned non-lilac chromatic, scoped to `custody-comparison.tsx` where it carries the surveillance metaphor (the custodian lane "sees" a green packet; the mint lane blurs it). It must not appear elsewhere on the page.

rules.name: The No-Pure-Black, No-Pure-White Rule
rules.body: Every surface and neutral tints toward a hue. The reference hue for neutrals is the sky's (~240–260): ink is `oklch(16% 0.015 260)`, muted/borders sit at hue 240–255. The dark set keeps its lilac-tinted values (`oklch(13% 0.003 280)` etc.).

rules.name: The Specimen Scale Rule
rules.body: Display 1 is reserved for the page's apex moment: the opening hero (currently "A Cashu Wallet.", `siteConfig.description`). No element in the body of the page ever reaches that size.

rules.name: The Wordmark Tier
rules.body: A single scale step exists above Display 1 — `type-wordmark` (`clamp(3.25rem, 18vw, 14rem)`, weight 600, tracking -0.05em). The 3.25rem floor is load-bearing, not a round number: 18vw alone would need a viewport ≥ ~356px to clear a 4rem floor, and below that "cashu.me" (one unbreakable word) overflows its container at the narrowest supported width (320px). It is reserved for the footer brand sign-off (a viewport-spanning `CASHU.ME`) and never appears elsewhere; it's a brand mark, not a heading, and operates outside the Display hierarchy.

rules.name: The Balanced Wrap Rule
rules.body: All headings carry `text-wrap: balance`. All long-form prose carries `text-wrap: pretty`. The page never ships a heading with an orphaned single word on the last line if the browser can prevent it.

rules.name: The Mono-as-Structure Rule
rules.body: Mono is structural, not decorative. It appears on chip labels, eyebrow labels, button labels, and the version stamp in the footer. It does NOT appear on body prose or headings. Decorative mono is costume.

rules.name: The Button-Label Rule
rules.body: Azeret Mono carries every button label on the page: the header CTA, the mobile-drawer wallet link, and the App Store / Play Store / Browser badges. Tracking is `0.06em` (looser than `type-label`'s `0.1em` so labels feel tappable rather than read as eyebrows), at weight 500 versus the label rule's 400.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrows Rule
rules.body: No `[N]` bracketed index marks, and no tiny uppercase tracked kicker above every section. `Section.tsx` supports an `index` prop for exactly this pattern; no live section passes one. This is a settled preference, not an oversight — do not add index marks or eyebrows to "finish" a section that doesn't have one.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Sections, prose, and hairline rules are flat at rest. Shadows are reserved for the frosted-glass recipe (interactive/illustrative surfaces) and for physical-object depictions (phones, banknote-style mockups). Never decorative elsewhere.

dos: Do keep Cashu Lilac at ≤5% of any screen. Its rarity is the point.

Do keep the frosted-glass recipe to its four named surfaces (buttons, nav pill, custody-comparison chips, bento cards) — one recipe, reused verbatim, not reinvented per component. The lone sanctioned extension is the nav pill: fully-round plus a navbar-only `--glass-sheen` highlight (see §5 Navigation). The other three surfaces stay plain.
Do use native `<details>` for accordions, `<a>` for buttons, `<section data-theme>` for theme scope. Lean on the platform.
Do cap body lines at 65ch using `max-w-[65ch]`. Cap lead lines at 48–55ch.
Do use `text-wrap: balance` on headings and `text-wrap: pretty` on prose.
Do keep the navbar a floating glass bar (see §5 Navigation), a fully-round pill carrying the shared recipe plus its own `--glass-sheen` highlight, inset from the viewport edges, not edge-to-edge.
Do serve any transparent pixel-art or soft-alpha PNG (logo, clouds) via next/image with `unoptimized` — its optimizer flattens alpha to black otherwise.
donts: Don't use neon-on-black crypto colors. No electric green/blue/orange neon, no 3D rendered logos, no futurist UI.

Don't use consumer-fintech pastels, friendly mascots, or gradient illustrations à la Cash App / Venmo / Revolut. The single page-wide sky gradient and its photographic cloud cutouts are the one sanctioned pastel-field exception — no additional pastel fields, no illustrated/cartoon clouds, no further gradients.
Don't lean on bank navy + gold institutional gravitas. Wrong register entirely.

Don't use Web3 / DeFi maximalism: rainbow accents, dashboard-heavy charts, chart-driven hero treatments, or glass used decoratively/everywhere. The one shared frosted-glass recipe on its four named surfaces is the scoped exception, not license for ambient glass.
Don't use card grids with icon + heading + subtitle templates. Sections are typographic compositions, not cards; the bento grid is the one named exception.
Don't use em dashes (`—` or `--`) in user-facing copy. Use commas, colons, semicolons, periods, or parentheses.
Don't use `background-clip: text` gradient text or border-left side stripes.

Don't use display fonts other than Manrope. No Switzer, no Satoshi, no Inter for display. Geist Sans is the body face; it does not appear on display or label runs. Azeret Mono is permitted only on labels and button labels, never on display or body.
Don't use Cashu Lilac (`#b4a7f5`) for text on white. Switch to Cashu Lilac Deep (`#7a66e8`) when on Specimen Cream.

Don't apply ambient shadows to flat surfaces. The only sanctioned exceptions are the frosted-glass recipe and physical-object mockups (phones, banknote-style), used at most once per section for the latter.
Don't ship a heading without `text-wrap: balance` or prose without `text-wrap: pretty`.
Don't redefine tokens at the call site. New utilities go through the `@theme inline` block in `globals.css`.
Don't add `[N]` index marks or a tiny uppercase kicker above a section to "finish" it. See The No-Eyebrows Rule (§3) — their absence is deliberate.

Don't claim "self-custodial" or "no custodian." Cashu is custodial: mints hold the underlying bitcoin. The accurate framing is bearer ecash plus unconditional withdrawal to any Lightning address. Candor is the brand; overclaiming corrodes it.
